Chapter 6939: Fool

Chapter 6939: Fool

The private showings were always successful without any problems. After all, there were many immortals present. Who would be foolish and suicidal enough to crash the party?

This was true until today. Everyone curiously took a look at the bold intruders. Treasure Immortal Lord’s expression darkened since this was a slap to his face.

However, they were surprised to see an overlord and a mortal strolling inside. This only embarrassed the lord further.

“Timeflow, what nonsense are you up to?!” An immortal yelled at Timeflow.

Timeflow noticed the incoming aura from his junior uncle and hurriedly bowed.

“From Heaven’s Equal branch?” This told everyone his background.

“Fellow Daoist, what is going on?” Treasure Immortal Lord was unhappy.

The issue was that this overlord was Heaven’s Equal Monarch’s granddisciple. He couldn’t just crush the overlord instantly.

His junior uncle was confused as well. Although people disliked Treasure Immortal Lord, it was still better to maintain friendly terms. Things could sour in a hurry, potentially leading to a conflict between the two branches.

“This ridiculous act demands punishment.” The junior uncle yelled.

In the past, Timeflow would have been frightened in this situation due to the presence of all these immortals. However, his neck grew stronger with Li Qiye right behind him.

“The great immortal demands the return of the ladies from Guardian Alliance. Please summon them.” Timeflow made up his mind.

The crowd couldn’t help whispering in shock. A few groups knew but didn’t dare to speak of it.

This was akin to playing with the beehive. The army of Guardian Alliance could come at any moment.

Treasure Immortal Lord truly wanted to show off his collection but remained sane enough to keep it a secret. Alas, it was too late.

“You deserve death for spewing lies.” Treasure became murderous; his aura froze the entire firmament.

“Fool, what are you doing? Go back and meditate for thirty million years in the prison.” Timeflow’s junior uncle stepped up and protected him with another aura.

“Fellow Daoist, this is more than just imprisonment, he harmed my reputation.” Treasure said, ready to attack.

Everyone else hurriedly retreated, aware of his intent to silence Timeflow.

Timeflow glanced at Li Qiye since this was now above his station.

“Stay back.” Li Qiye patted his shoulder.

His junior uncle was utterly confused when he saw Timeflow hide behind a mortal rather than run away. He could have convinced Treasure to spare the fool and play the whole thing off as a silly joke gone wrong.

“Hand them over, and I’ll grant your Breaker branch a swift death.” Li Qiye demanded.

“What?!” All eyes fell on him after hearing the illogical claim.

Initially, they thought he was Timeflow’s underling and didn’t pay attention. They immediately activated heavenly gazes to take a closer look.
